regions.today: Any early mist and fog will clear this morning to leave a dry and bright day with spells of sunshine. Isolated showers will drift across north Leinster this evening. Highest temperatures of 18 to 22 degrees in a light to moderate westerly breeze.
regions.tonight: Dry and largely clear tonight with the chance of just isolated showers in the north of the province. Lowest temperatures of 7 to 9 degrees in a light southwesterly or variable breeze.
regions.tomorrow: Tomorrow will be another bright day. After a dry start, scattered showers will spread from the west in the afternoon and evening. Highest temperatures of 17 to 21 degrees with light southwesterly winds increasing moderate westerly through the day.
regions.solar_uv: Moderate on Thursday and Friday, high in any sunshine.
